caveats: Demo allocation model only; true state dimensioning belongs in the Stage 3 engine build.
Opportunity scores are working signals from Signal Trends and interim ZIP3 bridge data.
Compliance statuses are FanDuel-owned source research, not legal advice.

scenarios.method: Allocate scenario budget across states by opportunity score times population weight, with governance masking. Not-listed, blocked, legal-review and unknown states receive no activation budget.
